messages.subject: ggplot 2 help
parts:

ggplot2 to load into R. Can someone please provide me with the code

messages.author: e4aec126ff1dca22
messages.subject: Re: ggplot 2 help
parts:
Have you tried

install.packages('ggplot2')
library(ggplot2)

If it worked when you type

?qplot

it should pop up with a help window, if not, an error.

david.
